goals.title: Upgrade the Mode You're Playing
goals.summary: Every mode here has a second layer you switch on yourself. With a mode already running, drop the ball in the right scoop to collect that mode's Upgrade. What you actually get is written into each mode separately: a couple of them hand you the entire shot set at once so the clock stops being the problem, while another leaves the shots exactly as they were and simply makes them pay more. Learning which mode gives which is the whole skill.
instructions: Right scoop - get a mode running first, then put the ball back in the right scoop to collect that mode's Upgrade.
Knowhere - an orbit-centric mode, though the ramps count too and the orbits just pay better. Upgrading lights the mode's shots, so you can bank advances instead of racing the timer.
Pod Chase - a ramp mode that wants ten shots. Upgrading lights the shots, which turns a long ramp count into something you can realistically close out before time runs out.
Quill's Quest - a hurry-up mode. The Upgrade here pushes the hurry-up value up rather than making the mode easier to finish, so it is a points play, not a completion play.

Sibling Rivalry - a combo and flow mode. Upgrading opens extra combo shots, and collecting one of them lights a bank of shots on whichever side of the playfield follows naturally from the shot you just made, so you can chain your way through.
goals.reward: A mode-specific Upgrade: Knowhere and Pod Chase light their shots for an easier finish, Quill's Quest raises the hurry-up value, Sibling Rivalry opens up combo chains

drills.title: Held Plunge to the White Shot
drills.text: Hold the left flipper and full-plunge around the left loop, which keeps the ball out of the pops and live, then take the flashing white shot inside the short window. It is usually the right ramp, but check before you commit — it can sit on the Orb or the right orbit instead.

drills.title: Orb by Hand
drills.text: Drop the Orb target, then hit the standup behind it, and repeat. The action button cannot make this shot at all, so there is no bailout — every Orb you collect has to be shot, which makes it the one shot worth over-practising.

drills.title: Rocket Miniloop
drills.text: Work the Rocket miniloop where it wraps the platform into the right orbit. Three shots is all the playfield doubler needs, so build it into your between-shot habits rather than saving it for when you need it.

drills.title: Nova Lane Change
drills.text: Cycle the two top rollovers and the stacked left inlanes with the flipper buttons, then complete the right inlane and park the multiplier on the Orb. The doubled-up left inlane is the awkward half of the set — practise moving the lit one under the ball before it arrives.

drills.title: Ramp Link
drills.text: Shoot the Guardians ramp, then combo straight into the cross-ramp while the link is live. The cross-ramp feeds the left inlanes, so the return sets you up to start the pair again — this is the fundamental repeatable flow on the machine.

drills.title: Orbit Repeater
drills.text: Alternate left orbit and right orbit back to back and pay attention to how each one feeds you. Under Super Loops the orbits get re-routed to return straight to a flipper, so the pattern you build here is the one that pays later.

actionButton.label: Hadron Enforcer
actionButton.how: The lockdown bar button fires the Hadron Enforcer. Sweep the five yellow standups scattered around the playfield and it loads three charges; each press hands you one lit shot for free, always grabbing the leftmost one available. Treat it as a rescue for shots you cannot hit under pressure, not as a way to finish anything big.

uses.when: Mode running with a hard shot lit
uses.what: Spends one charge to spot the leftmost lit shot, and you still get credit for any playfield multiplier.

uses.when: Groot or Orb Multiball jackpots lit
uses.what: Spots an ordinary jackpot, but never the final Super Jackpot of any multiball.
Will not spot it — that last shot has to be made by hand.
Switched off entirely; all five targets must be cleared yourself before the timer runs out.

howItPlays.objective: Guardians of the Galaxy sends the crew across the cosmos to keep the Orb away from Ronan. Run the character missions, build the multiballs, and finish all eight modes plus both multiballs to reach Save Xandar.
loop: Bash the two standups by Groot's jaw and the drop target at the Orb to open the game's two multiball locks.
Queue a character mission with the flippers, start it at the right scoop, and take its upgrade shot back at the scoop first.
Spell RAMPAGE at the Rocket loop for a doubled playfield, and complete the Nova Corps rollovers to lock a shot multiplier.
Finish every mission so its shot pays five times over during Groot Multiball, then re-lock for a playfield doubler and dump the multiplied jackpots.

lights.name: Mission Scoop
lights.lit: A lit right scoop launches whichever character mission you have queued, and each one runs on its own timer once it begins.

control.effect: cycles which of the eight character missions is queued up at the scoop, so you can line up the shortest or safest one before you commit
control.when: before you shoot the scoop to start a mission

lights.then: Drop back into the scoop mid-mission to take that mission's upgrade, since several then light all of their shots so the clock stops mattering, and finishing all eight modes plus both multiballs lights Save Xandar right here.

lights.name: Nova Corps Rollovers
lights.lit: A lit Nova Corps rollover is one of five you have not completed, and a rollover already collected stays lit, so only the dark ones are left to chase.

control.effect: a flipper tap nudges the lit Nova Corps rollover sideways across the two top lanes and the stacked left inlanes, so you can park it on the rollover the ball is rolling toward and grab the one still missing
control.when: before the ball reaches the rollovers, which matters most on the awkward doubled-up left inlane

lights.then: Complete all five rollovers to light the shot multipliers, then pin a doubler onto whichever shot you intend to lean on for the remainder of the ball; a roving triple follows once the whole set is qualified.

lights.name: RAMPAGE Loop
lights.lit: Each Rocket loop shot is a RAMPAGE letter, and because RAMP is spotted for free only three makes are needed to finish the word.
lights.then: Completing RAMPAGE switches on a doubled-playfield window, and another Rocket shot during it stretches the timer, so switch it on just ahead of a major multiball or mission instead of on a bare playfield.

lights.name: Groot Mouth Lock
lights.lit: Hitting the two standups flanking Groot opens the motorized jaw, lights the lock and arms the right-outlane save, and a ball fired into the mouth stays put.
lights.then: Lock three balls to start Groot Multiball, where finished-mission shots pay five times over; re-lock a ball while it runs for a doubled then tripled playfield, and Groot's mouth is the Super Jackpot in every multiball and wizard mode.

lights.name: The Orb
lights.lit: Drop the Orb target and strike the standup hidden behind it to collect an Orb, and three of them start the multiball, a shot the action button flatly cannot make for you.
lights.then: At the start the drop target banks the hurry-up jackpot value, and a quick Orb during the multiball doubles your next jackpot, so this is where you stack a RAMPAGE window and a Nova doubler for the game's top scores.

lights.name: Hadron Enforcer Targets
lights.lit: A lit yellow Hadron standup is one you have yet to sweep, and clearing all five loads the lockbar button with three shot-spot charges.
lights.then: Spend a charge to spot the leftmost lit shot when one is too hard to hit under pressure, but never on a Super Jackpot or the closing Rocket of Escape Kyln, and the button switches off entirely during Sanctuary.

lights.name: Yaka Arrow Pops
lights.lit: The three pop bumpers fire Yaka Arrows, spotting a shot every ten hits, and the always-lit Yondu dead-end lane collects whatever the pops have piled up.
lights.then: Run Yaka Arrow early while its values escalate fast, then shoot the dead-end lane once more after completing the mode to recollect the entire total plus fifty Super Pops as a carryover bonus.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper to nudge the lit Nova Corps rollover sideways across the top lanes and the stacked left inlanes, setting it on the rollover the ball is rolling toward so you collect the one still missing. Complete all five rollovers to light the shot multipliers, then pin a doubler onto the shot you intend to lean on for the remainder of the ball, with a roving triple to follow.

scoring.text: Bank a hands-free skill shot into the flashing top lane, then start an easy mission like Quill's Quest for its free two-ball safety net. Complete the Nova Corps rollovers and lock a shot multiplier onto something you can reliably hit.

Clear character missions to bank bonus and make their shots pay five times later, spell RAMPAGE for the doubled playfield, and start both Groot and Orb multiballs. Re-lock in Groot for a playfield doubler and dump multiplied jackpots for the biggest built score on the machine.

Save Xandar is the finale: finish all eight missions and both multiballs to light the scoop, collect every purple jackpot, and cash the ball-adding Super Jackpot. Immolation Initiative and the six-ball Cherry Bomb are the mini-wizards you clear on the way there.
